name: Hawk Mountain Ranger qualification tab: Advanced Ranger
size_basis: width 2.7 in: the tab as worn above the CAP tape on the HMRS 2021 uniform poster (assets/refs/capranger/hmrs-uniform-poster-2021.png), the tape taken as 5 x 1 in (417 x 83 px, 83.2 px/in; base-art/ranger-tab-poster-measure.js): red field 230 x 28 px = 2.76 x 0.34 in, light frame 240 px = 2.89 in wide (0.06 in ends and top; the bottom frame is hidden against the tape); 2.7 in is the master's reading of the same poster (field 226 x 26 px over a 418 x 82 px tape), kept as this pass reads within 7% of it; height 0.44 in = 2.7 / 6.134, the mean width / height of the ten tabs in CAPR 39-1 Figure A8-2 (6.00-6.27; capranger.org's tab graphic: 6.43), and the poster's field height 0.337 in over the figure's field share of the height (0.769) gives 0.438 in. The drawing is the LIVE13-ART 2 one (proportions and lettering measured on Figure A8-2 at a 5 in design width) scaled uniformly by 0.54
citation: CAPR 39-1 Figure A8-2 (Hawk Mountain Ranger Qualification Tabs); 7.1.1.4.2.1 (OCP: in lieu of the higher-headquarters patch on the left sleeve pocket, whose loop field is 4 x 6.5 in); 9.2.4 (HMRS graduates, one tab). Ethan, LIVE13-ART 3: "the ranger tabs arent authorized on ABUs!!! only on OCPs unfortunately in lieu of an hhq patch"
anchors_note: the five anchors the NCSA patches carry: the engine centres the tab (center) on garment-ocp-coat-abu-cut's hhq_patch_left_center, the left sleeve pocket's loop field, as it does those patches; OCP only, one tab, in lieu of the HHQ patch (7.1.1.4.2.1). LIVE13-ART 2's placement above_cap_tape and anchor seat_on_cap_tape (ABU / CFU wear above the CAP tape) are withdrawn
